evidence.reason: Line 449 uses `name not in expected or not source_declared`, so an undeclared unit file that references any CRQ name is appended to `foreign` even when the referenced unit is unrelated to the unit being switched. Because `_scan_dependencies` walks the entire unit directory, unrelated installed units (for example `crq-publisher.timer` naming `crq-publisher.service` while switching `crq-tick.service`) make discovery refuse. The cross-boundary check should flag declared sources naming units outside `expected` and undeclared sources naming units in `expected`, not every undeclared-source CRQ reference.
